verdict.rationale: Kit advertises apps that connect creator tools directly to Kit and an App Store built on its OAuth API (kit-docs-15, kit-docs-18, kit-docs-27, kit-docs-30). It also offers signed webhooks with retries and bulk APIs (kit-docs-21, kit-docs-24, kit-docs-40, kit-docs-39), so an ops user could build or adopt connections. However, nothing shows maintained first-party integrations with the named systems, and App Store apps appear to be third-party built. Missing for 10: any evidence of first-party Stripe or Shopify integrations, any Segment or other CDP connector, any product-database sync, and evidence that integrations are vendor-maintained.
